DS5Mac 1.0

The first release.

  • A live 3D view of the controller: every button, stick, trigger and the touchpad as you use them, tilting with the controller.
  • Lights: lightbar color and brightness, player LEDs, microphone LED.
  • Adaptive triggers: resistance, clicks and ramps on L2 and R2.
  • Vibration test, with patterns and intensity.
  • Profiles that switch by themselves for each game, or by connection.
  • Settings stay on in the background; DS5Mac waits in the menu bar and warns you when the battery is low.
  • English and Italian.
